title: Enactment of the New York City Building Code.
officialText:
The New York City Building Code based on the 2009 edition of the International Building Code published by the international Code Council, with changes that reflect the unique character of the city and amendments that bring it up to date with the 2015 edition of such International Building Code, is hereby adopted to read as follows:

(Am. L.L. 2023/077, 6/11/2023, eff. 6/11/2023)
